full_prompt_en: A square gallery photograph shows a mixed-media sculpture of one walking figure between two low wheeled clusters of rough humanlike forms. The setting is spare: a pale gray wall fills the background and a smooth concrete floor extends across the lower part of the frame. The central figure is shown in profile moving toward the right. Its dark brown head and hands contrast with a loose mottled green-gray jacket and trousers. One leg reaches forward and the other trails behind, giving the still object a strong walking stride. On either side, horizontal rods connect low carts with thin metal wheels. The left cluster spreads behind the walker, its irregular pale discs, rough folded surfaces, and a bluish rounded head rising above the cart. At the right, seated or curled forms crowd a similar small trolley, with overlapping beige and gray textured masses and feet projecting outward. The sculpted surfaces look assembled and weathered rather than smooth: patchy pigment, pale fabric-like folds, dark seams, and exposed slender supports give each volume an improvised quality. The carts sit at ground level, while the upright walker creates a tall central interruption in their long horizontal silhouette. Even gallery light from above and the front reveals the worn surfaces without dramatic shadow; faint contact shadows anchor the wheels and feet to the floor. There are no wall labels or readable words in the selected view. The photographed sculpture uses space around the objects as part of its effect, with generous blank wall above and to both sides. The overall composition is strange and processional, balancing recognizable bodily movement against fragmentary clustered shapes and the precise circular rhythm of small wheels.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形展厅照片呈现一件混合媒介雕塑：一个行走人形位于两组低矮、带轮的粗糙人形群之间。环境简洁，浅灰墙填满背景，平滑混凝土地面横过画面下部。中央人形侧身向右，深棕头和手与松垮的斑驳绿灰外套和长裤对照。一条腿向前跨，另一条拖在身后，使静止物体带有强烈步行动势。两侧的水平杆连着低矮小车，车上有细金属轮。左侧群块在行人后展开，不规则浅色圆片、粗糙折叠表面和一颗蓝色圆头从车上升起。右侧，坐着或蜷曲的人形挤在类似小推车上，米灰有肌理体块互相遮叠，脚向外伸。雕塑表面像拼装并风化过而非平滑：斑驳颜料、浅色布料般折面、深缝和外露细支架让各体积有临时搭建感。推车贴地，直立行人则在其长水平剪影中形成高挑中央中断。上方及前方均匀展厅光揭示磨旧表面，却没有戏剧阴影；浅浅接触影使轮子和脚扎在地面。选定视野里没有墙标或可读字。作品周围的空间本身也参与效果，上方和两侧保留宽裕空墙。整体构图奇异而像行列行进，以可辨的身体运动平衡碎片化群块与小轮的精确圆形节奏。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media sculptural imagery combines rough assembled volume with sparse, precise linear supports. Muted gray, faded green, beige, and earth brown stay close in value, allowing texture and shape to carry distinction. Surfaces appear patched, folded, abraded, and partly translucent, with uneven pigment revealing a history of making. Repeated circles and long low connectors create a measured horizontal rhythm, interrupted by a taller directional mass. Even neutral light lets small shadows describe contact points without turning the installation theatrical. Generous blank surroundings isolate the forms so their strange silhouettes and material differences remain readable. Edges alternate between hard metal lines and frayed, irregular masses. The overall effect is enigmatic and tactile, using the tension between improvised soft construction and clean underlying geometry to give the scene movement.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介雕塑影像把粗糙拼装体积与稀疏精确的线性支撑结合。灰、褪绿、米和土棕在相近明度中变化，让肌理与形状承担区分。表面像补缀、折叠、磨损并局部半透明，不均匀颜料显出制作历史。重复圆形与长而低的连接建立有节制的水平节奏，被较高的方向性体块打断。均匀中性光让小阴影描出接触点，却不把装置变成舞台。宽裕空背景隔离形体，使奇异剪影和材料差异清楚可读。边缘在硬金属线与磨散不规则体块间交替。整体效果难解且有触感，借临时感软质构造与干净底层几何之间的张力赋予场景动势。
theme_en: A walking figure passes between wheeled clusters of rough human forms
theme_zh: 行走的人形穿过两组带轮的粗糙人物造形
name: Sanford Biggers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
